Priya (CS): Heads-up: GreenTide reported three recurring onboarding frictions + two feature asks. Renewal in 6 weeks, they're vocal about ROI metrics. Can product weigh in on prioritization?
Aisha (CS): Raw highlights from last 2 calls: 
- "Search results feel unrelated after we upload custom docs — embeddings seem off for our domain." (customer engineer)
- "Would be huge to toggle per-route billing for our support workflows. We get billed across many tiny routes." (ops lead)
- "Bulk import of historical logs times out or spikes latency at 50k rows." (data lead)
Marco (PM): Thanks — can you paste the exact reproducer for the embeddings mismatch and a recent request id? Also, which route(s) are they calling that they want toggled?
Priya (CS): Request ID examples: req_2026_05_03_8812, req_2026_05_11_2019. They upload docs via our UI import (csv -> ingestion pipeline). Routes: /api/v1/generate-search and /api/v1/embeddings. Customer wants per-route billing so support and analytics aren't mixed.
Jordan (ENG): For embeddings mismatch — likely model selection or vectorization pipeline. Priya can you share a failing doc + expected vs actual snippet? if possible paste a minimal payload we can repro with (text + model + params).
Aisha (CS): Pasting sanitized example below:
```
{"text": "Post-op care checklist for pulmonary rehab", "model": "open-similarity-1.0", "metadata": {"customer_id": "greentide-42"}}
```
Customer expected nearest matches to be clinical templates; results were off-topic.
Riley (Product): My read: embeddings/domain mismatch is P0 (direct product experience + renewal risk). Per-route billing is P1 (billing flexibility and SKU work). Bulk import latency is P2 but could be mitigated with config changes. Propose: quick triage sprint for embeddings (2 engineers, 3 days) + product work item for per-route billing (spec + legal check).
Marco (PM): Agreed. Can we get an eng owner for the 3-day triage? Jordan volunteer?
Jordan (ENG): I can take the triage. Will create a minimal repro, run local vector store comparison (quantized vs float), and check model variant fallbacks.
Priya (CS): I'll open the customer-facing bug and set expectations: ETA for triage update in 48 hours. Also copying the GreenTide contact: sara.greene@greentide.com (FYI).
feedback-bot: Created internal ticket CS-4789 and linked to ENG-2210.
Riley (Product): Next steps: 
1) Jordan: triage + short doc with root cause hypothesis (48h).
2) Marco: add per-route billing RFC to backlog + estimate (next sprint).
3) Priya/Aisha: collect 3 more sample requests and confirm renewal stakeholder wants this prioritized.
Priya (CS): Will collect samples today and ping here when done. :thumbsup:
Aisha (CS): Noted — I'll schedule a short enablement session for GreenTide once we have the fix or a mitigation.
Marco (PM): Thanks team — please update CS-4789 with any customer quotes and repro artifacts.
Priya (CS): Link to notes: https://redwood.internal/notes/greentide-onboard-2026 (internal)
Jordan (ENG): Starting repro now, will report back in this thread.
Priya (CS): Closing loop for now. If product wants to deprioritize per-route billing, say so; otherwise I'll flag both asks in the renewal briefing.
